data_scope: Configuration roots are claimed in record_access as quotation_foundation.{kind}; own/team/company scope is checked on every write, query and replay.

idempotency.request_hash: SHA-256 of canonical full request including root and revision CAS fields
idempotency.replay: Rechecks exact action grant, read grant, human requirement, server object control, root data scope, historical references and source readability; does not rerun the action

evidence_boundary: Source verification state is a trusted local host assertion stored separately with immutable change events. Public JSON cannot mark evidence verified. This does not establish enterprise authenticity, legal tax correctness, or external source truth.
policy_boundary: An independent active pricing_policy is selected by a trusted host adapter and rechecked inside each publication transaction.
